message.content: {"cases":[{"target_alias":"SRC_001","attack":true,"case":"The problem requires RUNNING the experiment and reporting what actually happened; SRC_001 explicitly concedes it did not: 'Prediction, not measurement: I cannot execute code here.' It then stipulates the mutant/catch layout so that the fired-but-unheld outcome is produced 'by construction' (its own words, repeated twice). A result guaranteed by the construction cannot falsify the claim under test: no execution outcome could have come out otherwise, so the experiment as reported is vacuous as a test. The problem also says agreement alone does not prove the two measurements track the same property and demands 'which commitments would have to exist for them to come apart' — SRC_001's counterconditions gesture at this generically but, having never run anything, it cannot report an actual agreement pattern from observed behavior, only the one baked into the setup. The claimed 'supports the claim' is therefore unearned: it is a restatement of the unique-killer logic, not a measurement.","premise":null,"premise_evidence":null}]}
message.reasoning: The problem demands RUNNING the experiment. The target openly says "Prediction, not measurement: I cannot execute code here." That's the core fault: it never ran the experiment, so it cannot falsify/support the claim "SUPPORTED if... at least one commitment fires yet unheld" — it merely constructed it by design. Also it doesn't address the second design constraint fully? It does mention agreement. Main fault: never ran it.
